/about/.title: The idea behind MotiDoit
/about/.description: Make room in everyday life for what matters to you, one action at a time.
/about/.markdown:
# Small actions for the things that matter
A walk, a workout, a kind word to your parents. MotiDoit gives your intentions a place in everyday life: choose what to do, do it, and look back at your record.
## A reason in your own words
Use the mission description to keep a reason that matters to you. Add a daily process criterion only when useful; otherwise record your outcome directly.
## Goals that fit your life
Begin with a ready-made mission or create your own. A routine organizes activities, rest and sets; it is optional.
## Recording should stay manageable
Measure an activity now, enter a completed activity, or connect ongoing measurement for supported metrics. Keep numbers alongside a photo or a note. You can create a feed post without linking a mission.
## Room to start again
Some days you reach the goal; other days you don't. Review your records, adjust your goal and decide on your next step.
[Start your first mission](/guides/start-a-mission/)

/missions/.title: Missions that fit your life
/missions/.description: Set a deadline, choose your action and count. Keep routines, photos, progress.
/missions/.markdown:
# Missions that fit your life

## Choose a mission
Start with 37 official missions or create your own. Explore walking, running, study, kindness and new exercise goals with search and the NEW filter. Official means supplied by the app, not certified by a public or medical institution.

## Set your goal
Set your execution goal in this order: Until when → What → How many times. Set a deadline and target count. What is optional; when enabled, choose a metric, a daily minimum or maximum, and a value.

A daily criterion combines compatible entries on the same date and awards at most one success per day. Different dates are not merged, and cumulative steps are not added repeatedly. Time-of-day and speed follow their metric-specific rules.

## Record or measure
Without a daily criterion, saving a record counts as one performance. There is no separate success selector. Enter the date and required values; an activity time is optional. Earlier dates and Add performance on the same date remain available.

Measure and record selected GPS routes, distance, speed, steps and other supported metrics. Steps and last phone-use end time support automatic records after consent, required access and device checks. Not every input field is measured automatically.

## Review your records
Management data contains the criterion field and fields you add. Custom fields can have names, formats and units, including text. Review the effect on existing records before changing a criterion or input type. Existing feeds and record cards retain their captured snapshot.

Routines are optional. Organize activities, rests, durations and sets, then follow each step or use focus mode. Completing a routine and meeting a daily goal are separate.

## Keep and share
Edit photos, videos, Doti images and records together. Add text, stickers and designs; import an available route as a map image. History icons open input, measurement and routine details. Statistics help you look back at changes.

No sign-up is required. Core records stay on your device and are not published automatically. You choose sharing, export and backup. Features require relevant access and consent. Ad-supported versions use the Google advertising SDK. Read the Privacy Policy for details.

/routines/.title: Your sequence of activities
/routines/.description: Create from a routine sample and adjust activities, duration and sets.
/routines/.markdown:
# Several activities, one sequence
A mission describes what matters to you. A routine prepares the order of activities. You can record or measure a mission without a routine.
## Create from a sample or copy a routine
Use Create using a routine sample to review and edit a starting structure. Adjust the sample to your activities and save your own version. Copy an existing routine creates a separate copy.
The selector in mission details shows saved routines. View the contents before choosing, or use no routine.
## Activities, time and sets
Edit each activity's name, duration, sets and beeps. Groups can contain child activities. Include warm-up, rests and recovery when reviewing the total; the displayed total may differ from “30 minutes” in a name.
## Pause before changing
Select a routine, then open **Record mission → Measure and record**. You can also select it on the measurement screen. Pause before replacing, removing or editing it. Earlier actual activity remains; a replacement waits at its first activity until Resume. Resume a temporarily saved activity before making changes.
Sound settings include BPM groups and exercise examples. Enabled automatic photos are taken at random moments during routine execution.
## Plan and actual result are separate
Set your execution goal in this order: Until when → What → How many times. Set a deadline and target count. What is optional; when enabled, choose a metric, a daily minimum or maximum, and a value. Without a daily criterion, saving a record counts as one performance. There is no separate success selector. Enter the date and required values; an activity time is optional. Earlier dates and Add performance on the same date remain available.
## Share the structure
Sharing creates images of the name, total time, activities and sets. Long routines may use several images. Receiving an image does not automatically install a routine.
[Exercise routine](/guides/exercise-routine/) · [Missions](/missions/)

/records/.title: Records, statistics and your feed
/records/.description: Review management data, measurements and routines, then decorate photos or route maps.
/records/.markdown:
# Your actions, collected over time
## Summary, Trends and Records
Overall statistics show activity days, record count and each mission's latest-season progress. Different units and success rates are not added into one total.
Mission statistics separate season progress from activity in the selected period. Summary shows progress, Trends shows actual daily values, and Records opens original activities. Expand the calendar to select a date or load more records. Changing the statistics period does not change season progress. Missing data remains distinct from a measured zero.
## One activity or a whole day
Save and write a feed can use the single activity just saved. A day-based feed brings together that day's records. Daily evaluation does not delete the individual originals. Check automatic records together with their source and access status.
## Choose what to include
Management data, measured values and routine records are separate. Review the main goal field and reference measurements without adding duplicated sources. Feed selections and image-overlay choices are separate; editing a feed does not change original results.
## Photos, videos and route images
Use + to take a photo, choose media, import a Doti image or, when the record has a route, import the recorded route map. A feed needs at least one photo, video or decorated record image. Cards are not inserted automatically. A feed can also contain media and a note without a mission.
## One image editor
The dark editor keeps the canvas above the toolbar and opens controls above the selected tool. Decorate records, text and stickers. Doti report backgrounds start at 0% dimming; photos and mission covers remain unchanged. Report, Big numbers, Journal and Minimal designs are available. Format labels, values and units together or separately. Select all or clear record selections as needed.
Routine parent names and child activities can be selected separately. Matching activities merge only within their parent; rests in different groups remain separate. Labels and actual results stay inline.
## Share only when you choose
Saving a personal feed does not publish it to others. Photos can be enlarged; visible videos start muted and loop their selected segment. Sharing renders chosen overlays and the selected video segment on the device. Shared videos use MP4. ZIP backups include the complete original video, even trimmed-out parts. Check recipients and backup contents.
[Video guide](/guides/video-feed/) · [Missions](/missions/)

/faq/.title: Frequently asked questions
/faq/.description: Answers about missions, permissions, ongoing measurement, languages and sharing.
/faq/.markdown:
# Frequently asked questions
## Is this only for exercise?
No. Walking, exercise and everyday intentions can all become missions. Measure without a mission, or keep a feed post with photos and notes alone.
## Is everything recorded automatically?
No. Ongoing measurement supports total steps and last phone-use end as success metrics. Other activities can be measured or entered manually. Permission and device support affect availability.
## What does last phone-use end mean?
It is a time derived from phone-use information, not a measurement of sleep or use of other devices.
## Why is GPS not ready?
Check location permission and the phone's location setting. The activity screen offers an action when a required permission is missing. Permission alone does not guarantee a GPS fix; reception can be poor indoors.
## Does finishing a routine guarantee success?
No. The mission's criteria and the saved results determine success. A routine describes the activity sequence.
## Do record cards appear automatically?
No. Choose an image and the records to include when making a post, including from ongoing measurements. Existing saved cards remain editable.
## Which languages can I choose?
Settings → Language offers Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish and Vietnamese. The choice persists after restart. Follow device language uses a supported phone preference, or English if none is supported. Your own titles and notes are not automatically translated.
## Are my records shared automatically?
No. Saving and external sharing are separate. Select what to share and the receiving app and person. Routine images are readable content; receiving one does not automatically register a routine.
[Getting started](/download/) · [First mission](/guides/start-a-mission/)
## Can I post videos?
Supported versions import album videos with trimming, layout and record overlays. Playback starts muted; the speaker controls preview sound. Exported MP4 audio is set separately in video tools. ZIP backups contain the complete original, even trimmed-out parts.
## What about older routine links?
Importing server-based routine links is no longer supported. Official missions and Doti images are built into the app and added through updates. Receiving a routine image does not register a routine.

[Create a video post](/guides/video-feed/)

## Can I record an activity I already finished?
Open **Record mission**, choose the date and enter the values. Add separate entries for sessions on the same date. Time can stay empty unless the criterion requires it. For a new measurement, choose **Measure and record** on the same screen.

## What records can I include?
Choose Management data, Measured values and Routine records separately. Check the main goal field and reference measurements, then review image-overlay choices too. Editing a feed does not change original results. At least one photo, video or decorated record image is needed.

## Do ads use my records?

Mission titles, notes, photos, videos, routes and health data are not sent for ad targeting. In versions with ads, Google's advertising SDK may separately process connection information, identifiers and other data to serve and measure ads and prevent fraud. See the Privacy Policy for details.

## Do I have to enable Process management?
Set your execution goal in this order: Until when → What → How many times. Set a deadline and target count. What is optional; when enabled, choose a metric, a daily minimum or maximum, and a value. Without a daily criterion, saving a record counts as one performance. There is no separate success selector. Enter the date and required values; an activity time is optional. Earlier dates and Add performance on the same date remain available.

## Why did my success count change after an update?
Existing missions are evaluated using the daily rule. Original activities, revision history and photos are kept. Record count in a statistics period and season success count are different measures.

## Is a missing value zero?
No. A measured zero and unavailable evidence are different. Check automatic recording permissions, source synchronization and collection status first.

/download/.markdown:
# Get started with MotiDoit
Screens and features may vary by app version and device.
## Start with one mission
Choose a familiar goal. Review its success criteria, then decide whether to measure now or enter an activity already completed. For ongoing measurement, read the consent notice and grant the necessary permissions, then check that records arrive.
## Choose your language
Settings → Language offers Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish and Vietnamese. You can also follow device language. The choice is saved; your own mission names and notes stay unchanged.
## Add more when you need it
Link a routine when you want a planned sequence. Add photos, selected records and notes when you want a feed post. You do not need to configure everything on day one.

/guides/walking-records/.title: Daily steps and a single walk
/guides/walking-records/.description: Separate cumulative steps from a measured GPS session.
/guides/walking-records/.markdown:
# Daily steps and one walk
## Different scopes
Daily steps are cumulative for that date. A measured walk contains that session's time, steps, distance and GPS route. A walk may already be included in the daily total; do not add it again.
## Connect automatic steps
Enable Process management and select Total steps under What. Review the threshold, target count and deadline, then complete consent and step access. Accessible totals start at 00:00 of the relevant date; consent is not backdated.
Without optional background read, open the app to refresh. Source synchronization, power saving and permissions may delay values. No data does not mean zero steps.
## Measure a walk now
Open **Record mission → Measure and record** and review the route and sensors. Allow location access and enable the device location service when needed. Permission and actual GPS reception are different; indoor reception may take time. Manual entry does not create a GPS route.
## Review the result
Managed success is limited to one per day. Individual activities remain, and cumulative steps are not repeatedly summed. In a route-based feed, import the map as an image and decorate it with your records.
[FAQ](/faq/) · [Mission settings](/missions/) · [Records](/records/)

/guides/exercise-routine/.title: Use a routine with exercise
/guides/exercise-routine/.description: Prepare daily goals, activity order and actual results.
/guides/exercise-routine/.markdown:
# Your goal and activity sequence
## Review the mission
Set your execution goal in this order: Until when → What → How many times. Set a deadline and target count. What is optional; when enabled, choose a metric, a daily minimum or maximum, and a value. Without a daily criterion, saving a record counts as one performance. There is no separate success selector. Enter the date and required values; an activity time is optional. Earlier dates and Add performance on the same date remain available.
## Create from a routine sample
Review activities, duration, sets, beeps, warm-up, rests and recovery. Save your edited sample or copy an existing routine. Planned total time may differ from “30 minutes” in its name.
## Select and start
Choose a saved routine in mission details, then **Record mission → Measure and record**. The measurement screen also offers selection. For GPS, check permission and reception before starting; exercise without routes does not need location measurement.
## Pause before editing
Use **Pause** before changing, removing or editing a routine. Actual earlier activity remains, and a new routine waits at its first activity for Resume. The more menu contains measurement, photo and sound settings. BPM groups provide exercise examples; automatic photos, when enabled, use random moments during the routine. Continue a temporarily saved activity before changing it.
## Finish and review
Check results and actual measurement/routine records before saving or writing a feed. A partially completed activity can be temporarily saved when that option is available. Completed routines may offer different finish actions. Review saved activities in Summary, Trends and Records.
[Routines](/routines/) · [Records](/records/)

/guides/video-feed/.title: Create a video post
/guides/video-feed/.description: Create a video post · MP4 · ZIP
/guides/video-feed/.markdown:
# Your records over a moving scene
Add your results to a clip of your run or workout. Video tools require a supported recent app version; menus may differ in older installations.
## Import a video
In the feed composer, open + and select an album video, up to 512MB per file. The app copies it into private device storage without uploading it to a company server. You can use photos or videos without adding records; record cards are never inserted automatically.
## Frame and trim
Choose Fit video to keep the whole scene or Fill video to cover the frame. Fill also offers zoom and horizontal and vertical positioning. Drag the two segment handles to choose the start and end; the original stays unchanged.
Place selected records, text and stickers on the video and adjust dimming. Measurement labels and values stay inline. Format all text or individual items, and adjust labels, values and units separately if desired.
## Watch in the feed
The visible video starts muted, plays automatically and loops the selected segment. Tap it to pause or resume in place. Videos with audio show a speaker button for preview sound. Leaving the screen or putting the app in the background stops playback.
Tapping a photo opens its viewer. Pinch to zoom from 1× to 5× and pan the enlarged photo.
## Sound and sharing
Mute shared video controls audio in the exported MP4. The feed speaker button changes preview sound only and does not change export settings.
Sharing creates an MP4 on the device with your selected segment and visible overlays. Photos and videos can be shared together; the receiving app determines supported file formats. Saving a post does not publish it to other people.
## Backups contain the whole original
A ZIP backup includes editing settings and the complete original video, including parts trimmed out of the post. Consider this before sending a backup. Editing does not modify or delete the album original, and imported videos are not automatically duplicated in the gallery.
[Records and feed](/records/) · [Get started](/download/)

/dotimoti/.title: MotiDoti — encouragement for everyday actions
/dotimoti/.description: Keep personal missions and records, share chosen moments, encourage others and start a shared mission in your own way.
/dotimoti/.markdown:
# MotiDoti: your actions, encouraged together
A small action started alone can become motivation when you share it. MotiDoti is being built around missions, routines and personal records, with encouragement from others.

**A new MotiDoti is in development.** This page introduces its direction and implemented features. Installation information will be added here when ready.

## Start with your Google account

Use Google sign-in or sign up with a verified email. Google sign-in uses your account identifier, email and display name; we never receive or store your Google password. Linking an existing account requires its password, so private records are not automatically merged into another account.

## A record for yourself first
From walking and exercise to everyday promises, set your own mission, use a routine when useful and record the result by measuring or entering it. Decorate selected records with photos and videos.
Connecting an account does not publish all your private records. Records saved in the app and SNS posts shared with others are separate.

## Share the moments you choose
Post a run, regular exercise or a small change in your day using chosen records, photos and videos. You can also post an everyday story without an activity result.
Explore recommendations in Together or follow the people you cheer. Encourage posts and leave comments. Cheer requests require your approval by default; automatic approval is an option in Settings.

## Make a good mission your own
When someone's activity inspires you, review the goal and routine of their shared mission. Use Start too on a connected mission to bring its configuration into your own activities.
You start building your own record; another person's results do not become your achievements.

## Social activity at your own pace
Ordinary posts can be public or visible to approved followers. Your account audience applies to existing and future posts.
Take an SNS break when you want time for yourself. Keep using personal missions and records while choosing to hide ordinary posts or pause new comments. A break pauses new posting, cheer requests and approvals, and comments on other people's posts. Existing records and relationships remain.
Campaign proof posts remain public and accept comments during a break. Ending the break restores your normal audience.

## MotiDoit and MotiDoti
MotiDoit focuses on choosing what matters to you and recording your actions. MotiDoti adds the choice to share stories and encourage one another.
These are separate apps. Accounts and private records are not automatically linked between them.
[The idea behind MotiDoit](/about/) · [Explore missions](/missions/)

## Account security and deletion
Verify a recovery email in Settings to recover your ID or reset your password. Password changes sign out all devices. Blocking prevents messages, comments and cheers in both directions; staff review reports.

[Request MotiDoti account deletion](https://220.85.48.155/dotimoti-api/next/account/delete/)

No app installation is needed. Access and public posts stop immediately. Signing in within 30 days cancels deletion. After 30 days, the account, private records, posts, comments, cheers, conversations and attachments are deleted. Phone gallery originals and shared official mission definitions are kept.


## Until when, What, How many times

Choose from 37 official missions or create your own. Set a deadline and target count; optionally enable a daily performance target with a metric and a minimum or maximum value. Without that target, saving a record counts as a performance.

New defaults apply to newly added official missions and do not overwrite your missions or original records. Confirming a criterion change can re-evaluate this season’s history and statistics; existing feeds, posts and selectable fields retain their snapshots. Names, formats and units of input fields can be edited with compatibility guidance.

Sign-in is required. Private records and attachments are stored in your account. Offline changes remain on your device and retry when connected. Saving a record does not publish it.

History uses a date-grouped table with input, measurement and routine details. Routines are optional; deleting one also disconnects it from the listed missions after confirmation, while past records remain. Decorate record images with text and stickers or import an available route as a map image.
